generated.description: A large luxury super yacht built mostly from water, dark oak, black and gray terracotta, and quartz, with black stained glass windows and a few dark oak and quartz decks stacked along the hull. It is roughly 156 blocks wide, 56 high, and 29 deep, with about 55,000 blocks total, and it has chests, furnaces, signs, and a few hidden trap and skull blocks inside. The materials and the ice and snow blocks suggest it could sit on open ocean or a frozen sea.
